name: Jose Danilo Narvaez Arias
role: AI & Automation Developer | LLM, RAG & Python Backends | VoIP & DevOps

headline.text: I build automation on infrastructure I

bio: Fourteen years in IT, six of them at Emtelco. Started in telephony, moved into the Linux and container infrastructure underneath it, then into automating that infrastructure, and now into the AI systems built on top. Python and Bash first. Self-hoster and privacy advocate, with a completed AI specialization.

experience.title: AI & Automation Developer
experience.description: Build AI and automation solutions for contact center and telephony operations. Develop RAG pipelines and LLM-backed services with Python and FastAPI. Automate internal processes and third-party integrations, packaged with Docker and shipped through CI/CD.

experience.title: Telephony Engineer
experience.description: Design and implement enterprise SIP telephony solutions. Build WebRTC contact center platforms with Asterisk and Kamailio. Automate VoIP provisioning and monitoring with Python, Bash, and Docker. Manage Linux infrastructure, Nginx reverse proxies, and CI/CD pipelines.

experience.title: Telephony Analyst
experience.description: Analyzed and optimized telephony infrastructure. Developed Python-based automation tools for Asterisk AMI/ARI. Implemented Prometheus and Grafana dashboards for real-time VoIP monitoring. Managed SBC configurations and Genesys Cloud BYOC integrations.

experience.title: Help Desk Analyst
experience.description: Provided technical support for telephony systems and network infrastructure. Resolved escalated tickets for SIP, VoIP, and network issues. Documented processes and contributed to knowledge base development.

experience.title: Back Office Employee
experience.description: Back office for Vodafone, one tier behind the front line. Router provisioning, connectivity faults, and the Linux hosts running the service.

experience.title: Help Desk Specialist
experience.description: Front line for Claro Hogar subscribers. Static IP, DMZ and NAT on home routers, and the escalated faults across broadband and voice. Where the networking came from.

education.school: UNIR | Universidad Internacional de La Rioja
education.description: Postgraduate specialization focused on Python, TensorFlow, containerized LLM environments, and DevOps for AI pipelines.
Bachelor degree in Systems Engineering. Core focus on telecommunications, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and backend development with Python and Linux.
Specialized diploma in cybersecurity operations and Cisco network defense. Training focused on CyberOps, threat analysis, and incident response.

capabilities.title: AI & automation
capabilities.description: Retrieval pipelines and LLM-backed services that plug into systems already in production. Most of the work is the data, the retrieval quality and the eval loop, not the model call.

capabilities.title: Telephony & real-time
capabilities.description: Call paths debugged end to end, from signalling and SDP down through NAT traversal to the media itself. Platforms where a dropped call is an incident, not a bug report.

capabilities.title: Infrastructure & DevOps
capabilities.description: Every host reproducible from a repository. Nothing configured by hand, nothing deployed from a laptop, and a dashboard for anything worth being woken up for.

achievements.title: Self-Hosting Purist
achievements.description: Runs personal infrastructure on a single Raspberry Pi 4: a handful of self-hosted services behind nginx, provisioned with Ansible and reachable only from inside the tunnel.

projects.name: doction
projects.description: Self-hosted, markdown-first wiki and knowledge base for humans and AI agents. PostgreSQL full-text search, optional local semantic search, per-page git history, a REST API, and a native MCP server for agent integration. MIT licensed.

projects.name: pulse_bogota
projects.description: Backend-first REST API that estimates how busy a place in Bogotá is without counting people. Blends public signals into an Activity Score and a complementary Discovery Score, with Alembic migrations, a scheduler that recalculates every 15 minutes, and weekly OpenStreetMap imports.

projects.name: WhatsApp ISP Support Bot
projects.description: Automated WhatsApp technical support bot for ISPs. Combines a local RAG (BM25) knowledge base with Llama 3 via Groq for fast responses, integrated with Twilio WhatsApp and deployed with Docker.

projects.name: Coffee Tracker API
projects.description: Minimalist API for logging coffee intake by caffeine (mg) and drink type, consumable directly from iPhone Shortcuts. Fastify and Prisma over SQLite, with bearer-token auth, daily and aggregate stats endpoints, and OpenAPI docs.

projects.name: RAG Without LLM
projects.description: Retrieval and ranking pipeline that answers by quoting its sources, with no generative model in the loop. Hybrid search combines PostgreSQL pgvector similarity with local Hugging Face embeddings and cross-encoder reranking; served via FastAPI with a Streamlit UI.

projects.name: prometheus_ocupation
projects.description: Exporter that queries Prometheus with custom PromQL and writes the results to structured CSV at hourly resolution. Retry logic and structured logging make it usable as an unattended reporting job.
